sentence: This project builds a computer system that helps deep learning tools quickly analyze large amounts of neuroimaging data.
This project supports work on genes, proteins, brain circuits and behavior to understand vision and diseases affecting the visual system.
This project develops a diffusion MRI method to image neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease without invasive procedures.
This project studies two communication systems between organs that control body size and function as an organism develops.
This project builds a deep learning model that designs mRNA sequences to boost protein production and make the mRNA last longer.
This project studies how extracellular vesicles travel through the body, including how they cross the blood-brain barrier and reach specific tissues.
This project uses metabolomic and genetic approaches to find biomarkers that predict how well people with asthma respond to inhaled corticosteroids.
This project uses imaging to test whether small vessel disease in the brain progresses faster in women than men, and how Equol affects it.
This project studies heart and vascular diseases, with work that spans basic science through population and outcomes research.
This project improves a software tool that outlines structures and lesions in medical images using artificial intelligence.
This project studies how biomaterials can change the gut microbiome to activate the immune system.
This project builds a data analysis center and a cell culture facility to expand research in data science, cell culture and molecular imaging.
This project provides shared lab services that study immune responses in samples from experiments on lung transplant tolerance.
This project builds a chatbot that helps patients understand their providers' notes in electronic health records.
This project uses genomic tools to tell relapses of Plasmodium vivax malaria apart from re-infection in clinical trials.
This project supports research in mental health behavior genetics using advanced techniques.
This project studies how memory T cells drive periodontal inflammation and alveolar bone loss in periodontitis.
This project tests whether a walking program with pain education is workable and acceptable for veterans with chronic pain and opioid use disorder.
This project uses lipid nanoparticles to make immunoPET probes and find the best way to give them to patients.
This project makes viral and non-viral vectors that deliver CRISPR-based tools to airway cells for gene therapy research.
